University Transport Boarding Guidelines
  • Students must show their official City University ID Card with valid semester sticker when boarding.
  • Varsity bus service operates Saturday through Thursday during academic sessions.
  • For Friday special examination or event schedules, please check notice board 24 hours prior.
  • Transport Emergency Hotline: 01819-223344 (Ext. 302 / transport@city.edu).
